title: Branching and commit conventions
situation: The operator, 2026-10-15, confirmed after two read-backs: the workflow becomes intent-based delegation instead of a prescribed procedure. Branches were cut per cut or change.
decision: Cratylus follows GitHub flow: a short-lived branch per task, merged into dev by pull request; dev merged into main by pull request for release; a session may run an integration branch ahead of dev for one change and says so. Commit only your own paths, by name; never amend or rewrite shared history. Pushing needs the operator's say-so.
consequences: Stated in the repository's working conventions.
